## Project Overview

This notebook prepares **CYBHI EBP/CDEP** Child PTSD Symptom Scale, 5th Edition (CPSS-5) assessment data for analysis and reporting. It ingests two raw eInsight exports (interviewer and self-report versions), processes the two-row hierarchical headers, computes total scores, and pairs each client's initial assessment with their last follow-up.

**Data sources:** `CPSS-5-Interviewer.csv` and `CPSS-5-self.csv` — eInsight Individual Assessments exports. Both are CSV files with two-row hierarchical headers.

**Scoring:**

- Sum of symptom items Q1–Q20 only (the **first 20** `_score` columns). Any later `_score` columns (e.g., the 7 functional-impairment items) are excluded from the total and listed in the output.
- Items are rated 0–4; values that are non-numeric or outside 0–4 are set to `NA` (and counted).
- Total score range: 0–80. Higher scores indicate greater PTSD symptom severity.
- A clinical cutoff score of ≥31 can be used to identify a probable PTSD diagnosis (`initial_above_cutoff`, `follow_up_above_cutoff`).
- **A lower follow-up score indicates a positive outcome.**
- Missing items: `total_score` is set to `NA` if more than `cpss_max_missing` items (default 2, i.e., ≥3 missing) are missing. This also prevents a blank form from scoring 0.

| Symptom Severity | Score Range |
|------------------|-------------|
| Minimal          | 0–10        |
| Mild             | 11–20       |
| Moderate         | 21–40       |
| Severe           | 41–60       |
| Very Severe      | 61–80       |

**Pairing logic:** Clients are grouped by `client_system_id`. The first assessment is the initial; the last assessment (if ≥2 exist) is the follow-up. Clients with only one assessment are excluded. No minimum gap is enforced; `days_since_initial` is included so a gap rule can be applied downstream.

**Outputs:**

| File | Contents |
|------------------------------------|------------------------------------|
| `cpss_i_paired_clean.csv` | One row per client: initial/follow-up scores, `positive_outcome`, `score_change`, quarter labels, severity bands, cutoff flags, `days_since_initial` — interviewer version |
| `cpss_s_paired_clean.csv` | Same, self-report version |

# Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(zoo)

# ---- Configuration: edit paths and reporting window here ----
in_dir  <- "/Users/cristin/CWS Dropbox/Cristin Young/CYBHI Project/Data/eInsight Exports/Individual Assessments"
out_dir <- "/Users/cristin/CWS Dropbox/Cristin Young/CYBHI Project/Rebecca and Tristan and Cristin/EInsight Data"

start_date <- as.Date("2024-01-01")
end_date   <- Sys.Date()   # set to a fixed date (e.g., as.Date("2026-09-30")) to freeze the data window

# Maximum number of missing symptom items (of 20) before total_score is set to NA
cpss_max_missing <- 2
```

# Helper Functions

```{r helpers}
# ---- Shared helpers (identical across the cleaning scripts) ----

# Reads an eInsight assessment CSV export with two-row headers.
# Row 1 holds question text (merged cells export as blanks and are forward-
# filled); row 2 holds sub-headers ("Response", "Score", ...). Returns a data
# frame with combined snake_case names and fully blank columns removed.
# "0" is deliberately NOT treated as missing: it is a valid rating on most tools.
read_assessment_csv <- function(path, na_vals = c("-", "", "NA", "N/A")) {
  raw <- read_csv(path, na = na_vals, col_names = FALSE, show_col_types = FALSE,
                  col_types = cols(.default = "c"))

  h1    <- unlist(raw[1, ], use.names = FALSE)
  h2    <- unlist(raw[2, ], use.names = FALSE)
  h1_ff <- na.locf(h1, na.rm = FALSE) |> str_squish()

  new_names <- ifelse(
    is.na(h1_ff) | h1_ff == "",
    h2,
    paste(h1_ff, h2, sep = " - ")
  )
  new_names <- janitor::make_clean_names(new_names)

  df <- raw[-c(1, 2), ]
  names(df) <- new_names

  df |> select(where(~ !all(is.na(.))))
}

# Parses eInsight date strings in ISO (2024-03-15) or US (03/15/2024) format,
# with or without a time stamp. Warns with a count of non-blank values that
# could not be parsed (these become NA and are dropped by the date filter).
parse_einsight_date <- function(x, label = "date_completed") {
  x   <- na_if(str_squish(as.character(x)), "")
  out <- as.Date(parse_date_time(
    x,
    orders = c("Ymd", "mdY", "mdy", "Ymd HMS", "Ymd HM", "mdY HMS", "mdY HM"),
    quiet  = TRUE
  ))
  n_bad <- sum(!is.na(x) & is.na(out))
  if (n_bad > 0) {
    warning(label, ": ", n_bad, " non-blank value(s) could not be parsed as dates and were set to NA.",
            call. = FALSE)
  }
  out
}

# Removes demo/test rows (provider_id or client_system_id contains "DEMO") and
# rows with no client_system_id (they cannot be linked or paired). Rows with a
# missing provider_id are kept. Prints a count for each.
remove_demo_rows <- function(df, label) {
  missing_ids <- setdiff(c("provider_id", "client_system_id"), names(df))
  if (length(missing_ids) > 0) {
    stop(label, ": column(s) needed for the demo filter not found: ",
         paste(missing_ids, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
  }
  is_demo   <- coalesce(str_detect(df$provider_id, "DEMO"), FALSE) |
               coalesce(str_detect(df$client_system_id, "DEMO"), FALSE)
  no_client <- is.na(df$client_system_id) & !is_demo
  cat(label, "- rows read:", nrow(df),
      "| DEMO rows removed:", sum(is_demo),
      "| rows with no client_system_id removed:", sum(no_client),
      "| rows with missing provider_id (kept):", sum(is.na(df$provider_id) & !is_demo & !no_client), "\n")
  df[!is_demo & !no_client, ]
}

# Converts item columns to numeric. Values that are non-numeric or outside
# [min, max] are set to NA and counted (e.g., a stray "9" or text in a score column).
clean_item_scores <- function(df, cols, min, max, label) {
  num   <- df[cols] |> mutate(across(everything(), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x))))
  raw_m <- as.matrix(df[cols])
  num_m <- as.matrix(num)
  n_non_numeric  <- sum(!is.na(raw_m) & is.na(num_m))
  n_out_of_range <- sum(num_m < min | num_m > max, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (n_non_numeric + n_out_of_range > 0) {
    warning(label, ": ", n_non_numeric, " non-numeric and ", n_out_of_range,
            " out-of-range (", min, "-", max, ") item value(s) set to NA.", call. = FALSE)
  } else {
    message(label, ": all item values are numeric and within ", min, "-", max, ".")
  }
  df[cols] <- num |> mutate(across(everything(), ~ if_else(.x < min | .x > max, NA_real_, .x)))
  df
}
```

## Score and Pair

Both versions share identical scoring and pairing logic after header processing.

```{r pair-helper}
score_and_pair_cpss <- function(df, label, clinical_cutoff = 31, max_missing = cpss_max_missing) {
  score_cols_all <- names(df)[endsWith(names(df), "_score")]
  if (length(score_cols_all) < 20) {
    stop(label, ": expected at least 20 score columns but found ", length(score_cols_all), call. = FALSE)
  }
  score_cols <- score_cols_all[1:20]
  if (length(score_cols_all) > 20) {
    message(label, ": using the first 20 score columns as Q1-Q20. Excluded from the total: ",
            paste(score_cols_all[-(1:20)], collapse = ", "))
  }

  scored <- df |>
    clean_item_scores(score_cols, min = 0, max = 4, label = label) |>
    mutate(
      missing_count  = rowSums(is.na(across(all_of(score_cols)))),
      total_score    = rowSums(across(all_of(score_cols)), na.rm = TRUE),
      total_score    = if_else(missing_count > max_missing, NA_real_, total_score),
      date_completed = parse_einsight_date(date_completed)
    ) |>
    select(client_system_id, collection, date_completed, total_score) |>
    filter(between(date_completed, start_date, end_date))

  cat(label, "rows after scoring:  ", nrow(scored), "\n")
  cat(label, "missing total_score: ", sum(is.na(scored$total_score)), "\n")

  severity_band <- function(score) {
    case_when(
      score <= 10 ~ "Minimal",
      score <= 20 ~ "Mild",
      score <= 40 ~ "Moderate",
      score <= 60 ~ "Severe",
      score <= 80 ~ "Very Severe"
    ) |> factor(levels = c("Minimal", "Mild", "Moderate", "Severe", "Very Severe"))
  }

  scored |>
    group_by(client_system_id) |>
    arrange(date_completed, .by_group = TRUE) |>
    summarise(
      n_assessments   = n(),
      initial_date    = first(date_completed),
      initial_score   = first(total_score),
      follow_up_date  = if_else(n_assessments >= 2, last(date_completed),  as.Date(NA)),
      follow_up_score = if_else(n_assessments >= 2, last(total_score),     NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(follow_up_date)) |>
    mutate(
      # Lower follow-up = positive outcome (lower symptom severity is better)
      # 1 = improved, 0 = no change, -1 = worsened
      positive_outcome = case_when(
        follow_up_score <  initial_score ~ 1L,
        follow_up_score == initial_score ~ 0L,
        follow_up_score >  initial_score ~ -1L
      ),
      score_change           = follow_up_score - initial_score,
      initial_quarter        = paste0("Q", quarter(initial_date),    " ", year(initial_date)),
      follow_up_quarter      = paste0("Q", quarter(follow_up_date), " ", year(follow_up_date)),
      initial_severity       = severity_band(initial_score),
      follow_up_severity     = severity_band(follow_up_score),
      initial_above_cutoff   = initial_score   >= clinical_cutoff,
      follow_up_above_cutoff = follow_up_score >= clinical_cutoff,
      days_since_initial     = as.integer(follow_up_date - initial_date)
    )
}

summarise_cpss <- function(paired) {
  paired |>
    summarise(
      n_paired           = n(),
      n_improved         = sum(positive_outcome ==  1, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_no_change        = sum(positive_outcome ==  0, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_worsened         = sum(positive_outcome == -1, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_improved       = round(100 * n_improved / n_paired, 1),
      n_missing_outcome  = sum(is.na(positive_outcome)),
      n_fu_within_3_days = sum(days_since_initial <= 3, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
}
```

# 1. CPSS-5 Interviewer Version

```{r cpss-i}
cpss_i_raw <- read_assessment_csv(file.path(in_dir, "CPSS-5-Interviewer.csv")) |>
  remove_demo_rows("CPSS-5 Interviewer")

cpss_i_paired <- score_and_pair_cpss(cpss_i_raw, label = "CPSS-5 Interviewer")

cat("CPSS-5 Interviewer paired clients:", nrow(cpss_i_paired), "\n")

summarise_cpss(cpss_i_paired)
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 2. CPSS-5 Self-Report Version

```{r cpss-s}
cpss_s_raw <- read_assessment_csv(file.path(in_dir, "CPSS-5-self.csv")) |>
  remove_demo_rows("CPSS-5 Self")

cpss_s_paired <- score_and_pair_cpss(cpss_s_raw, label = "CPSS-5 Self")

cat("CPSS-5 Self paired clients:", nrow(cpss_s_paired), "\n")

summarise_cpss(cpss_s_paired)
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 3. Write Clean CSVs

```{r write-csvs}
write_csv(cpss_i_paired, file.path(out_dir, "cpss_i_paired_clean.csv"))
write_csv(cpss_s_paired, file.path(out_dir, "cpss_s_paired_clean.csv"))

cat("CSVs written successfully.\n")
```
